medal_2001.jpg.title: Medal presentation Smithsonian Code Talkers Bush (16925866277).jpg
medal_2001.jpg.description:
P5828-15A

President George W. Bush salutes the Navajo Code Talkers during a ceremony at the U. S. Capitol July 26, 2001. "In war, using their native language, they releaed secret messages that turned the course of battle. At home, they carried for decades the secret of their own heroism," said the President who presented medals to 21 Native Americans who served during World War II.
